title: Chapter 978
text:
On the Divine Mechanical Throne, crackling sounds could be heard, and thick arcs of Mechanical Force shot out like whips, leaving charred marks on the ground.

His brain felt a slight tingling pain, as though he was being electrocuted.

With his eyes shining brightly, Han Xiao could clearly feel that the cells in his body were operating at full power, continuously spitting out energy.

After a few minutes, this symptom finally subsided, and the world in his eyes changed slightly. He now had a clearer mechanical perception, and his vision was deeper into the microscopic structure.

"How magical …"

Han Xiao narrowed his eyes and felt this change.

Using the Character Summon Card and having this talent felt completely different. The current [Perfect Mechanical Sense] was the reason why his body had changed.

His basic attributes did not change, but his Mechanical Force was strengthened, as well as his perception of machinery. In his senses, machinery became more familiar and intimate.

The core effect of Perfect Mechanical Sense was the total Machinery Affinity of 1.4x. According to Han Xiao's attributes, it increased his Machinery Affinity by around 2,000 to 3,000, which was a huge leap!

There were two secondary effects. First, when he used Mechanical Force, his Machinery Grade would increase by one to two grades, with the highest grade not exceeding Pink. Currently, Han Xiao's equipment was basically all Orange equipment, so this bonus was no longer of much use to the current Han Xiao. The other effect was more important. It increased the level of all Mechanic skills by four, which could break through the upper limit. At the very least, he had gained a few more slots for Apostle Weapons.

The Mechanical Sense talent was a personal talent, and the difficulty of learning it in the later stages varied from person to person. Some geniuses could easily learn it, but some would not be able to learn it even if they were extremely strong. Han Xiao's [Elementary Grade Mechanical Sense] was obtained from a mission, so the chances of him upgrading it to [Perfect Mechanical Sense] were basically zero.

Generally speaking, this kind of talent was either passively awakened or actively cultivated from a young age. It would become a habit when one was at their most malleable age. As the saying went, one's name would spread far and wide in the future. Young age was the best time to cultivate one's talent, and as one grew older and stronger, the difficulty of learning talents would increase accordingly.

"I've finally obtained Perfect Mechanical Sense. My normal combat strength is finally on par with when I use the Character Summon Card."

Han Xiaoxin was very satisfied. He had been looking forward to this ability for a long time.

Now, I'm finally not embarrassed, ahahaha!

Only strength that belonged to oneself was the most reassuring. Turning the explosive trump card into a normal combat strength greatly increased his stability. Now, he could be considered to have completely secured the qualifications to be a peak Beyond Grade A Mechanic, and the gap between him and the Mecha Empire had also been greatly reduced.

However, it was still too early for him to wrestle with Manison. Manison still had Perfect Mechanical Sense, and this was only a small gap.

Han Xiao was not in a hurry. Although he was also a peak Beyond Grade A, he was different from everyone else. He still had plenty of room for growth.

Before the next major upgrade, Han Xiao did not want to have any new disputes with Manison. While Manison felt that he had consolidated his position and could not be shaken, he secretly developed to prevent the other party from seeing through the speed of his improvement and adjusting his strategy to deal with him.

Although Han Xiao was not afraid of Manison doing anything to him, before he completed the foundation of the Flickering World, he did not want to create more problems. After all, Manison had the protection of the Radiant Federation. Furthermore, he was a cunning rabbit with many burrows, so he could not do anything to the other party.

"However, although Perfect Mechanical Sense has become my normal combat strength, it does not mean that I've lost this trump card."

Han Xiaoxin's heart skipped a beat.

The Character Summon Card had nothing to do with one's abilities. For example, a Character Summon Card that could increase one's state would be affected even if the character was in the same state.

In other words, the Perfect Mechanical Sense Character Summon Card was still useful to him.

Now that he had Perfect Mechanical Sense, he would have the chance to double his strength.

With the two of them stacked together, how terrifying would that be? This should be the only double Perfect Mechanical Sense in the universe. This is probably a little too awesome … Han Xiao mumbled to himself. Just thinking about it made him feel scared.

If he used it in front of Manison, the other party's worldview would probably be shattered.

"Thus, it's best to leave the blank Character Summon Card to Reynold or Nero. Whether I get it or not will depend on my luck."

Han Xiao experienced the Perfect Mechanical Sense for a while before closing the talent introduction.

Returning to the skill list, he pulled down the blueprint tab and looked at a new blueprint that he had recently obtained.

[Spacetime Splitter]: Uses a special spacetime technology to open up a new branch that exists temporarily outside of the main timeline. Designates and completes a pre-set action plan to form a timeline that has a beginning and an end. It breaks through the continuity of spacetime and performs a time jump to reduce the process. Can be used on any object.

This device has an irreversible negative effect. Objects that are cut by spacetime will be corrected by the main timeline. Once completely corrected, the object will be annihilated along with the branch timeline. If the timeline is completed smoothly, the object will also be annihilated and disappear.]

After Han Xiao stole the Spacetime Splitter Technology from the Kunde Race, he learned it once and spent some experience to deduce this technology. In the end, he obtained this new blueprint and spent some time to create a finished product.

Standing up and walking down from his throne, Han Xiao went to the warehouse beside him and took out a rectangular device that was more than ten meters tall and four to five meters wide.

This was the finished product of the Spacetime Splitter, and it looked like a three-story building.

Over the past few days, he had done some simple tests on the Spacetime Splitter, and it operated normally. It was just that the activation time was a little long. Furthermore, it did not work out of thin air. He had to connect the Spacetime Splitter to the target in advance before it would work.

Of course, Han Xiao would not use such a dangerous device on himself. However, after thinking about it for the past few days, this thing seemed to be of great help to Mechanics.

The most suitable target to use the Spacetime Splitter was the mass-produced mechanical army!

He did not feel the pinch of consuming mechanical soldiers at all. With this additional function, he could perform some tactical missions that he could not do in the past. His combat ability would have a qualitative improvement, which was equivalent to exchanging his endurance for a few levels of tactical assault ability. To a Mechanic with an army, this was naturally very worth it.

Secondly, it could also be used as a new strategic killing weapon. Compared to portable psionic bombs and biochemical weapons, the Spacetime Splitter was much more stealthy and difficult to detect. It was more suitable for assassination and destruction.

Han Xiao stroked his chin and pondered.

However, I should use it as little as possible. In the future, when the dynasty realizes the power of the Spacetime Splitter, they will start to hide and monopolize this technology. Although with my status, the dynasty will not force me to take back the technology in my hands, they will definitely ask me to keep it a secret.

There was no need to hide the fact that he had the Spacetime Splitter Technology from the dynasty. He had only stolen a copy before the dynasty monopolized it. He did not plan to hide it, and there was no need to.

If the Empire knew that he also had this technology, it could also raise his status. After all, he had stolen the chicken before the Empire paid attention to him. It was legal and not something that could not be exposed, so there was no need to hide it. Moreover, if he used this technology on others in the future, it would be exposed sooner or later. Perhaps the Empire would help him hide it.

In any case, no matter what, he would not spit out the fat meat that he had eaten.

Shaking his head, Han Xiao put away these thoughts. He took out a Spacetime Amber, hung it in midair, and connected it to the external port of the Spacetime Splitter.

Today, he was going to test if the Spacetime Amber could be affected by the Spacetime Splitter. This was his first time doing this experiment.

The operation of the Spacetime Splitter was a little complicated. Han Xiao fiddled with it for a while before activating it.

Buzz buzz buzz!

The entire device vibrated immediately. Streams of colorful light flowed through the pipes and into the Spacetime Amber.

He took a few steps back and waited silently for a while. Only then did the vibrations of the device gradually stop.

"The splitter is complete …"

Han Xiao's eyes flashed. He cut off the nanoparticles that were hanging the Spacetime Amber. The Spacetime Amber fell smoothly. It did not skip frames according to the preset program.

Narrowing his eyes, he picked up the Spacetime Amber and played with it in his hand for a while. He confirmed that there were no changes at all.

"Looks like the Spacetime Amber is immune to the Spacetime Splitter."

After coming to this conclusion, Han Xiao breathed a sigh of relief. This was good news for him.

The fact that the Spacetime Splitter could not solve this Space Wonder meant that the Spacetime Amber was still an unsolvable method. Even if the dynasty or more organizations obtained this technology, the Spacetime Amber in his hands would still be irreplaceable.

After thinking about it, Han Xiao conducted a new experiment.

He used the Spacetime Splitter on a normal machine and then wrapped it in the Spacetime Amber to see if the side effects of the Spacetime Splitter would still take effect.

The principle of the Spacetime Amber seemed to be a solidified special spacetime. The machine wrapped in it did not suffer the side effects of the Spacetime Splitter. It seemed to ignore the correction ability of the timeline.

However, at the same time, the normal effects of the Spacetime Splitter would not take effect.

After unwrapping the Spacetime Amber, the machine was corrected by the main timeline and self-destructed. It released a huge amount of energy and almost blew up the warehouse.

"In this case, the Spacetime Amber can only temporarily freeze the object and help it dry out. It can't cancel out the side effects of the Spacetime Splitter … So, it can only be used as a coffin? That's the same meaning as the amber. "

Han Xiao brushed the dust off his body and fell into deep thought.

"Maybe there are other methods. For example, I can set up the Spacetime Splitter in advance and seal it. Then, I can use the amber's attack immunity ability to send it to the target location using the normal method. Then, I can unlock the amber and activate the Spacetime Splitter effect … Hmm, this is equivalent to a delayed detonation."

Thinking about it, Han Xiao instinctively felt that this was an application with great potential. He still needed time to explore more possibilities.

After testing it a few more times to ensure that there were no mistakes, he put away the Spacetime Splitter. After thinking about it, he took out his communicator and contacted the dynasty's exploration army commander, Tarrokov.

After the call connected, Tarrokov's face appeared on the screen. The background was the strategy conference room, and it seemed like a meeting was in progress.

"Black Star, what's the matter?"

"You're in a meeting? I'll call you back later. "

"It's just a routine meeting. It's not as important as you. Just say what you want to say."

Han Xiao smiled. "The enemy's movements have been a little strange recently. You've noticed it too, right?"

"Hmm, the enemy seems to be luring us deeper. Do you have any information on this?"

"More or less. I sent out troops a while ago and destroyed the enemy's database. I discovered that the enemy is using a scorched earth tactic. They want to use the Primordial Psionic Energy to devour these few Star Systems and cause damage to the dynasty's fleet. I have the coordinates of the psionic energy planted by the enemy as well as the movements of their entire fleet. "

"Well done." Tarrokov's eyes sparkled, and he felt gratified.

The other Beyond Grade As did not have much interest in this war. Firstly, as experts, they were not interested in bullying a native civilization that did not have a Super system. Secondly, they were afraid that the enemy would randomly throw out the Primordial Psionic Energy and embarrass themselves. Thus, they only sent their subordinates to respond to the call.

Black Star was the only Beyond Grade A ally who personally came to help. He was indeed a talent that the dynasty valued.

"I'll send you the information later. Don't forget to record my contribution," Han Xiao said half-jokingly.

"Haha, don't worry. I'll definitely record your contribution." Tarrokov was in a good mood and felt that Han Xiao was more and more pleasing to the eye.

Han Xiao smiled and hung up the communication.

With [Perfect Mechanical Sense] and the Spacetime Splicing Technology in his hands, he planned to end this war as soon as possible and resume his normal exploration work.

Another reason for providing this information was to raise the evaluation of the Kunde Race's war mission. Since he had already completed his other objectives, he might as well help the dynasty get rid of the enemy as soon as possible.

Because he did not plan to hide the fact that he possessed the Spacetime Splicing Technology, Han Xiao did not hold back and directly took out the information.

…

Tarrokov was extremely efficient, and he immediately made arrangements after receiving Han Xiao's information.

The numerous armies on the frontlines all sent out their troops to the coordinates indicated in the information to destroy the enemy's scorched earth plan.

In the information provided by Han Xiao, the coordinates and movements of all the Kunde Race fleets were recorded. The dynasty had a clear view of the enemy's every move.

The armies on the frontlines no longer pushed forward slowly but spread out and headed toward the main fleet of the Kunde Race.

The Kunde Race still did not know that all their plans had been exposed and were under the control of the dynasty. They were still carrying out their battle plan.

With Han Xiao's help, the dynasty saved a lot of effort and easily crushed the Kunde Race in terms of intelligence.

The scales of victory were completely tilted toward the dynasty.
